title: CI executes implementation workspace under pinned toolchain
description: Objective: make G1/G2 execute every Rust workspace member under the repository pinned nightly. Non-goals: no test weakening, workflow redesign, new dependencies, or claims status change. Dependencies: none; this repairs an observed gate bypass. Owned file: .github/workflows/ci.yml. Immutable inputs: rust-toolchain.toml and cargo metadata workspace_members/default_members at the implementation revision. Deliverable: CI check, clippy, and test commands explicitly scope --workspace --all-targets where applicable, and RUST_TOOLCHAIN matches rust-toolchain.toml. Independent gate owner: fresh verifier or GitHub Actions. Required tests: workflow inspection plus cargo fmt --check, cargo check --workspace --all-targets, cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings, cargo test --workspace. Benchmarks: none. Claim/discrepancy effect: no capability promotion; restores advertised G1/G2 scope. Cancellation/resource/failure: normal GitHub job timeouts remain; any workspace failure blocks. Forbidden shortcuts: default-member-only commands, exclusions, warning suppression, ignored failures, or changing tests.
acceptance_criteria: 1. cargo metadata proves more workspace_members than workspace_default_members. 2. G1 uses cargo check --workspace --all-targets and cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings. 3. G2 uses cargo test --workspace. 4. Workflow nightly exactly matches rust-toolchain.toml. 5. Local workspace gates pass or every unrelated concurrent failure is reported without closing. 6. br dep cycles is empty and closure cites exact commit/gates.
